facts.text: Middlebury runs on a 4-1-4 calendar featuring a four-week winter term each January, during which students take only one intensive course.

sources.title: Curriculum | Middlebury College
sources.quote: The Middlebury curriculum operates on a 4-1-4 academic calendar. Students enroll in four courses in the fall semester, four courses in the spring semester, and a single course during the winter term. Winter term is a four-week term during the month of January
